# WWNT Robotics

> WWNT Robotics helps universities, labs and small startups make robot dreams come true — bipedal humanoids, robotic arms, dexterous hands and open-source kits.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://wwnt.ai/): Company overview and featured robots.
- [MicroDuck](https://wwnt.ai/microduck.html): Open-source robot duck kit — 15 × HD1901M TTL bus servos, 3D-printed body, IMX219 camera and IMU. $649 Ex-Works, pre-order with 30-day lead time. Complete robot available as a study sample only — limited to one (1) unit for study/evaluation.
- [Global Supply](https://wwnt.ai/microduck-supply.html): MicroDuck manufacturing & integration, authorized FEETECH supply chain, complete robotics ecosystem; complete robots, DIY kits, spare parts, technical support and educational packages.
- [MicroDuck Accessories](https://wwnt.ai/microduck-accessories.html): Set of MicroDuck Parts (Excluding 3D Plastics Parts) — $479; plus spare Feetech HD1901M servos, IMX219 camera, LSM6DSV16X IMU, VL53L8CX ToF, NP-F550 battery and debug board. 3D-printed parts not included (self-print).
- [Pricing / Store](https://wwnt.ai/store.html): Full product catalog and pricing.
- [Open Source](https://wwnt.ai/opensource.html): Open-source community, SDK and simulation demos.

## MicroDuck (product)

- **Name**: MicroDuck Open-Source Robot Duck
- **Brand**: WWNT Robotics
- **Price**: $649 USD (Ex-Works)
- **Availability**: Pre-order, 30-day lead time
- **Limitation**: Complete robot — study sample only, limited to one (1) unit for study/evaluation
- **Type**: Fully assembled open-source robot duck kit
- **Actuators**: 15 × HD1901M TTL bus servos (5–8.4 V, 10 kg·cm stall torque, 0.09 s/60°)
- **Body**: 3D-printed (PLA structural, TPU foot pads)
- **Sensors**: IMX219 160° wide-angle camera, LSM6DSV16X IMU
- **Power**: NP-F550 battery (8.4 V Li-ion, approx. 2200 mAh)
- **Open source**: GitHub — https://github.com/UnitClaw
